notes.title: 1.5.6 - Time for a performance boost!
notes.content:
Thank you for reporting bugs and sharing your experience.

Improvements

- No more lag when upgrading items at a higher tulip count (5k+)
- The "Choice panel" (if you've reached 1 billion tulips) will minimize instead of disappearing so you can still opt to reset at a later point)
- Friends-only leaderboard filter
- "Load more" leaderboard button
- Help translate panel invites users to join the Discord
- No errors if Discord is not running (should not be noticeable for the end-user)

Enjoy!

FYI: We are also giving away some DLCs for free on our Discord. Make sure to join and participate :)

notes.title: Release + 1 month | Let's recap!
notes.content:
On February 5th, Tulips & Windmills was released on Steam as free to play. We've released six big updates and countless on-the-go fixes, localization updates, and hotfixes.

What have we achieved?

 Zoom feature
 Unlimited* amount of levels and upgrades
 *Reached a billion tulips? Get an achievement and a golden tulip, then start over with a boost. Otherwise, continue playing until your device gives up.
 Sinterklaas boost offers a 10% bonus instead of 100 tulips
 Leaderboard showing off your golden tulips and total tulip count
 Better readability of numbers (1,234,567 instead of 1234567)
 Better UI icons that don't look entirely pixelated
 Localization into Dutch, German, Turkish, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, French and Frisian
 Works on more monitor sizes and in windowed mode
 Bug and crash reporting

None of this would have been possible without your continuous support, ideas and feedback! <3

What is coming next? Take a look at our roadmap and join our Discord server to stay up to date! You can also suggest features there, report bugs, and help translate the game into different languages.

If you've enjoyed Tulips & Windmills, we would love it if you could leave a review on Steam and on Metacritic. It helps show the store page to more people on Steam.

notes.title: 1.5 - The Golden Tulip
notes.content:
NEW
- Golden Tulips
At 1 billion tulips, you are now offered to exchange your progress for a golden tulip and start from the beginning with an extra 1% boost on your income. The more often you reset after one billion, the higher your boost will be. This will also show on the leaderboard in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45406094/bb625200aba765329a0fb090ca9a6ee87a436027.png

Improvements
- Performance improvements
- UI improvements (more icons!)
- "Billionaire's Club" achievement detection has improved
- Warning is shown when critical number values are reached
- Your Discord rich presence now shows in your language (if available)
- Slowed down leveling of the manual click multiplier and gardener

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45406094/b4016a9969452ac4ad00bf66060c6f074541d77c.png

Join us on Discord! See the store page for an invite link. If you enjoy the game, it would be awesome if you could leave a positive review.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: 1.4.4 - Hotfix of Infinity & Leaderboard
notes.content:
Turns out infinity is not that simple! 

Many of you experienced issues with prices turning negative, leaderboards not updating anymore, or the game outright crashing. 

With this update, some of these issues have been addressed:

New way of handling numbers! You should be able to achieve a much higher score and upgrade types instead of getting negative values.
(Slight) performance improvements - let us know if you notice a difference.
Leaderboard functions differently now and supports way higher scores as well. You may still notice some values being higher than yours in the leaderboard as they are old scores.
  

In the future, we are considering offering the choice between continuing at 1 billion or resetting for a special reward and a 1% bonus for the next round (props to Puppy for the idea!).

Let us know what you think! 
Thanks for playing.

notes.title: 1.4 - Play forever
notes.content:
NEW
- Infinite upgrades! Play it forever ːsteamhappyː
- "Billionaire's Club" achievement ːsteammockingː
- Auto saving (every five minutes)
- Leaderboard

Join our Discord to suggest any changes (link is on the store page).

Why don't take a look at the leaderboard right now? https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1883980/leaderboards/15916512

notes.title: 1.3 - Bug fixes, optimization, Turkish and Frisian!
notes.content:
NEW
- Turkish translation
- Frisian translation
- Improved UI icons

Improvements
- UI scales better to your screen size
- Resize your window when in windowed mode
- Car no longer (de)spawns in the air
- Improved settings panel (larger dropdowns)

Bug fixes
- "Logs" button functions properly now
- Loading does no longer double your boosts
- Only one boost can be active at the same time
- Mailbox no longer gets stuck

...and a lot of under-the-hood changes for a mobile app :eyes: 
Next, a performance boost will be released sooooooon.

Please report any bugs in #bugs on our Discord server or in the community forum!

notes.title: 1.2 - Colorful tulips & Windowed mode!
notes.content:
This is more of a bug fix update for you all but there's also something new:

 You can now set your game to windowed mode and enjoy the autoclicker while working on your thesis or chatting on Discord!
 Boring fields? No longer! Tulips now populate your fields in various colors!
 Did your game get stuck on loading? You were probably too rich! Nonetheless, you will also be able to play again now. 


Let us know your thoughts in #general & #suggestions on Discord (see store page) or via the community forum!

Thanks for all your input! 🌷

notes.title: 1.1 - Thank you!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all your feedback, input and bug reports!
I did not imagine that many people would try out this little game and even enjoy it :D 

Update 1.1

Features

 Zoom in using C (or bind a different key to this function in the settings)
 Increased amount of levels
 The Sinterklaas boost now offers a variable amount of 10% of your tulip collection instead of 100 tulips.
  
Bug fixes

 Fixed display of UI elements on screens with a 16:10 resolution or worse ;)


Please note that if you already have a savegame (older than 2 PM UTC yesterday), you may not be able to reach the highest level as your game will show you have reached the max level. I will see how this can be resolved for future updates.

Please continue to reach out to us via Discord and the community forum (see store page for links)

Thank you and happy tulip farming!
